tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /cha gsum gyi 'grel ba bgegs gtor gtong tshul dang bcas pa bzhugs/

༈ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung*/ /gcig bsdus rig sngags 'chang ba kun gyi dpal/ /snang srid dregs pa sde brgyad yongs kyi rje/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gang zhig bsten na mi mthun phyogs zhi zhing*/ /mthun rkyen 'dod don 'grub pa'i thabs kyi cha/ /phyogs skyong gdon la mchod cing 'phrin bcol ba'i/ /cha gsum gzhung gi bshad pa cung zad bri/ /'di la gsum/ sngon 'gro spyir bshad pa/ /'grel pa nyid bshad pa/ /'phros bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya'i 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa mang du gsungs shing*/ de'i nang nas 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das kyi lha dang gdon gyi rigs la mchod pa'i tshul mang du bshad la/ khyad par du sngags phyogs du ma dang brgya rtsa'i cho ga sogs nas phyogs skyong dang gdon gyi rigs la gtor ma sbyin pa'i tshul mang du 'byung zhing*/ de dag gi gnad bsdus pa ni da lta cha gsum du grags pa 'di'o/ /lhag tu 'phral gyi 'gal rkyen zlog pa la phyogs skyong rnams la mchod cing bskul ba ni gal che bar sems te/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang kun tshe sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i mngon dkyil gyi skabs su ni 'di rnams la gtor ma phul te 'phrin las bcol ba'i tshul cho ga du ma las bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs tsam du ma zad/ gang zag gzhan nad gdon gyis zin pa la yang phyogs skyong rnams la mchod cing 'phrin las bcol na phan khyad che zhing phyag len du'ang snang la/ gdon bgegs kyi rigs la gtor ma sbyin zhing 'phrin las bcol ba'ang phan pa'i rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /cha gsum la ni rgyas bsdus gsum snang yang da lta'i phyag len 'di ni 'bring bo'i dbang du mdzad par sems la/ kun rig ṭīka chen las ni 'di bsdus pa yin par bshad de/ 'bring gi bsdus pa tsam yin gyi/

bsdus pa dngos min no/ /cha gsum zhes pa ni gtor ma gsum gyi dbang du byas la/ de yang phyogs skyong dang gdon dang bgegs kyi gtor ma gsum ste/ rdo rjai 'byung ba las/ gtor ma dang po gnyis las ma gsungs kyang*/ jo bo shraddhas bgegs gtor dang gsum bya bar gsungs la/ sbyong rgyud las ni/ gnod sbyin srin po'i kha zas su/ /gtor ma rnam pa sna tshogs bzhag /ces dang*/ de nas 'byung po kun gyi gtor ma bya/ /sems can bkres shing skom la btung ba dang*/ /phyogs na gnas pa rnams la rnam par brtag /de yi gtor ma ji ltar mthun par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don 'chad pa na/ /ṭīka chen las/ gnod sbyin srin po zhes sogs kyis bgegs dang*/ phyogs na gnas pa zhes sogs kyis phyaugs skyong dang*/ 'byung po kun la zhes sogs kyis gdon dang*/ sems can bkres shing zhes sogs kyis yi dwags kyi gtor ma ste bzhi bya bar bshad do/ /'bul ba'i sngags ni a kā ro'am/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bhyo sogs gang rung ste/ rang rang gi sngags rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyi mthar sbyar nas 'bul zhing*/ phyogs skyong gi mtshan sngags rgyas pa ni/ oṃ ru tra ye zhes sogs yin la/ bsdus pa ni/ oṃ da sha dika zhes sogs so/ /'bul ba'i gnas ni dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs su sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu bya ba yin yang*/ de ji lta ba bzhin bya dka' bas gnas gang yang rung bar stegs kyi khar chu gnyis nyer spyod rnams dang*/ gtor ma bzhi pa rgyan dang bcas pa bshags par bshad cing*/ gtor ma'i rgyu ni ṭīka chen las/ 'bras yos/ til/ 'bras chan/ me tog /chu/ sran chan/ snum khur/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum la sogs pa rnams dang*/ khyad par bgegs gtor sha chang la phug dang bcas pa'o zhes gsungs shing*/ 'dir tshig zin la zan ma bgrang yang sogs sgras bshad cing*/ da lta gtor ma kun zan las bya ba bzhin te rung ngo*/ /lha gang gi sgo nas bya ba ni/

brgya rtsa lta bu la spyan ras gzigs kyi sgo nas byed pa ltar des kyang rung mod/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs su de dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis kyang chog cing*/ slob dpon kun snying gis hūṃ mdzad kyi rnal 'byor gyis bya bar bshad pa ltar 'dul 'dzin chen pos kyang ṭīka chen las de bzhin du bya bar gsungs so/ /da lta phyag len la ni bgegs gtor gyi sngon du hūṃ mdzad du bsgyur te de yang rung ngo*/ /nad pa sogs kyi ched du glo bur gyi cha gsum byed na ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis hūṃ mdzad du bskyed nas khro bo spyan 'dren mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rung byas te/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul tshul gzhung ltar byas pa'i mthar/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i zhes sogs sam/ bden stobs brjod pa tsam byas te/ gtor ma phyir skul nas sher snying gi zlog pa bya ste cung zad cig 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ /bsdus pa la ni khro bo spyan 'dren gyi skor bzhag kyang chog go /gnyis pa 'grel ba nyid bshad pa la gsum/ gtor ma byin brlab bya ba/ 'bul tshul so sor bshad pa/ phul nas gshegs gsol bya tshul lo/ dang po ni/ 'dul 'dzin pa'i kun rig gi cha gsum las/ gtor ma cha gsum/ yi dwags kyi gtor ma/ nyer spyod dang bcas pa bshams la/ bsang*/ gzi byin bskyed nas mchod pa rnams sngar ltar byin gyis brlab zhes 'byung ba tsam las gtor ma bskyed tshul mi snang ba ltar/ da lta phyag len du'ang gtor ma sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs pa dang bskyed par mi mdzad cing*/ bskyed kyang mi 'gal zhing legs pas bskyed na/ kun rig gi sngon 'gro'i skabs bzhin nam brgya rtsa'i gtor ma byin rlabs ltar bya/ bsang ba ni kun rig la badzra yakṣa dang*/ spyi 'gro la badzra a mṛ tas bsangs/ byin gyis brlabs pa ni 'dir sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gi sgo nas yin la/

dang po chos nyid rnam dag gi phyag rgya ni g.yas pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan te sor mo lhag ma gsum so sor bsgreng ba dang*/ de'i sngags don la/ oṃ swa bhā wa ni rang bzhin/ bi shuddhe'i bi ni rnams par/ shuddhe ni dag pa/ dharmaḥte ni chos nyid/ badzra siddhi ni rdo rje'i dngos grub/ thog ma'i oṃ ni sngags kyi 'go 'dren dang*/ mjug gi hūṃ ni thugs kyi sa bon te byin gyis rlob byed do/ /bsdu na rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i chos nyid kyi rdo rje'i dngos grub ces pa ste 'dis sbyong ba'o/ /gnyis pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya ni thal mo bkan la snyim pa'i tshul du byas pa dpral bar bzhag cing*/ de'i sngags don la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo ni phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la/ bi shwa ni sna tshogs/ mu khe bhya ni sgo nas/ sarba tata ni rnam pa thams cad du/ khaṃ ni nam mkha'/ utga te ni 'phags pa/ spha ra ṇa ni 'phro ba'am khyab pa/ hi maṃ ni 'di/ ga ga na ni nam mkha'/ khaṃ ni dbyings su/ swāhā ni gzhi tshugs sam/ legs pa sbyin zhes pa ste 'dis mang bor spel ba'o/ /gsum pa bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya ni lag pa'i sor mo bsnol la gung mo gnyis rtse mo sbyar nas bcag ste dpral bar bcings shing bstem la/ sngags ni oṃ a mṛ te'i ma ri ta ni 'chi ba dang*/ a dgag tshig yin pas thad 'gyur la 'chi med du 'gyur ba yin na'ang*/ don 'gyur la bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'o/ /hūṃ phaṭa ni der bskul zhing gsal bar byed pa ste/ 'dis bdud rtsir bsgyur bar byed do/ /bzhi pa 'dod don 'byung ba'i phyag rgya ni/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bzhag cing*/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ sngags la oṃ a kā ro ni a zhes bya ba'o/ /mu khaṃ ni sgo'o/ /sarba dharmāḥṇaṃ ni chos thams cad do/ /arya nutpan na twa ta ni ma skyes pa'i phyir zhes pa ste/

a zhes bya ba ni ma skyes pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o zhes pa'o/ /'dis so so'i 'dod pa sgrub par byed do/ /lnga pa rgya chen shugs ldan gyi phyag rgya la/ /g.yas pa khro bo'i khu tshur bcings te bsgrengs nas rdzas la gtad cing se gol gdab/ sngags ni/ na maḥ/ sarba ta thā ga ta ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa/ a wa lo ki te ni kun nas gzigs pa/ sambha ra sambha ra ni yang dag par ram kun nas rgyas pa rgyas pa'o/ /'dis so sor thob par byed do/ /drug pa dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ni g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ sngags la ru ru ni lha la bod pa'i sngags dang sphu ru ni gsal bar byed pa/ dzwa la ni gzi brjid 'bar ba/ tiṣṭha ni gnas pa/ siddha lotstsha ni thogs med du grub pa'i spyan zhes bshad cing*/ de'i siddha ni grub pa/ lotstsha ni spyan zhes pa ste thogs med kyi skad dod dngos su mi gsal lo/ /sarba artha ni don thams cad/ sā dhā ni zhes pa grub pa dang 'grub pa gang rung du 'gyur zhing*/ swāhā ni sngar ltar ro/ /'dis mnyam por thob par 'gyur ro/ /sngags dang phyag rgya 'di rnams la cung zad mi 'dra ba re yang 'byung ngo*/ /de nas bden pa'i byin brlab bya ba ni/ sgrub pa po bdag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i stobs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs kyi stobs dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i stobs rnams kyis/ bdag cag gi 'dod pa'i don rnams gang dag yid la bsam pa kun nam/ de dag thams cad ci ltar rigs par thogs pa med par 'byung bar gyur cig /ci ltar rigs pa ni thams cad min na'ang skabs kyi 'dod don gyi gtso bo rnams dang*/ thogs pa med pa ni bar chad med par myur du dang*/ 'byung gyur ni 'grub par shog ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'bul tshul so sor bshad pa la gsum las/ dang po phyogs skyong spyan drangs nas 'bul ba la spyan 'dren ni/

spos thogs te pus mo 'dzugs pa'am/ min yang rung ste/ mgon po phyogs skyong kun 'dir gshegs shing gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ 'on kyang da lta'i dus ni sems can snyigs ma/ tshe snyigs ma/ nyon mongs snyigs ma/ dus snyigs ma/ lta ba snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus skabs 'dir ni gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan na yang*/ mgon po khyed rnams kyis sngon rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i spyan sngar de'i bstan pa dang sems can rnams srung zhing skyob par khas blangs pa'i don sgrub pa dang*/ der ma zad/ bdag cag rnams la'ang phan gdags pa'i phyir du gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ zhes mdor bstan nas/ mgon po phyogs skyong de dag ni 'jig rten skyong la dbang bsgyur bas dbang dang ldan pa dang*/ snying rje che zhing thabs la mkhas pa dang*/ thugs dam tshig la gnas pa dang*/ dkyel po che ni blo khong yangs pa la bshad de thugs dgongs rgya che ba'o/ /de gang zhe na/ steng gi tshangs pa dang*/ shar gyi brgya byin la sogs pa lha dang*/ shar lho'i me lha drang srong rnams dang*/ yi dwags kyi rigs su gtogs pa lho phyogs kyi gshin rje dang*/ lho nub kyi srin po dang*/ nub phyogs kyi klu dang*/ rigs 'dzin nub byang gi rlung lha dang*/ byang gi gnod sbyin rgyal po dang*/ byang shar 'byung po'i gdon gyi bdag po dbang phyug te/ phyogs skyong gi 'khor de dag rang rang so so'i dbang po ste gtso bo'i skur ston pa tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so 'tshal ba ste/ ji snyed mchis pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na/ 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir du khyed rnams la mchod par byed kyis gshegs su gsol lo/ /e hye hi ni tshur spyon tshur spyon/ da sha dika ni phyogs bcu'i/ lo ka bā la ni 'jig rten skyong ba/ sa pā ri wa ra ni 'khor dang bcas pa/

sa ma ya ni dam tshig can no/ /ru tra ye ni drag po ste dbang ldan nam dbang phyug /sha ta sa ha sra akṣi ni mig brgya stong pa la ste/ sha ta brgya/ sa ha sra stong*/ akṣi ni mig go /agne ni me ste me lha/ ya ma ye ni gshin rje la/ wa ru ṇa ye ni chu bdag la/ ba ya bai ni rlung ste rlung lha la/ ku be ra ni lus ngan ste gnod sbyin la/ urdhaṃ ni steng gi prahma na ya ni tshangs pa la/ surya ni nyi ma/ gra ha ni gza'/ a dhi pa ta ye ni lhag pa'i bdag po la/ tsand+ra ni zla ba/ nakṣa tra ni rgyu skar/ a dhi ba ta ye ni de'i bdag po la/ ardhwa ni 'og gi pṛ thi wi bhyaḥni sa'i lha mo la'am de'i ched du/ a su ra bhyaḥni lha ma yin gyi ched du ste/ de yang su ra chang yin kyang a dgag tshig tu bzhag pas chang med du 'gyur yang*/ don thob kyis lha ma yin du 'gyur ro/ /nā ge bhyaḥni klu'i ched du zhes pa'o/ /sa pā ri wa ra ni 'khor bcas/ pra wa ra sad ga raṃ ni bsnyen bkur ba/ arghaṃ pra tī tstsha ni mchod yon so sor bzhes zhes so/ /ka ma la ye st+waṃ ni padma la khyod ces pa ste gdan 'bul ba'o/ /de nas/ oṃ ru tra ye zhes sogs dang mchod sngags kyi don sngar ltar la/ pādyaṃ nas shapta'i bar ni zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar gyi ming ngo*/ /de nas bstod phyag ni/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin te phyag mtshan rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /de ni sum cu rtsa gsum man chad kyi lha rnams kyi rgyal po ste/ lha'i gdon dngos sam de'i rigs gtogs kyi bdag po'o/ /des gtso byas pa'i shar phyogs kyi lha'i gdon gyi tshogs dang bcas pa la mchod pas mchod cing yon tan gyi sgo nas bstod de/ der ma zad gus 'dud kyis phyag kyang 'tshal bar bya'o/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin dngos ni ri rab kyi steng gi dbus na yod kyang de'i sprul ba gcig ni ri rab kyi shar phyogs skyong ba'i tshul du de na yod par bshad la/

brgya byin ni lha dang lha'i gdon gyi rgyal po yin yang lha gdon min la de'i 'khor gyi lha la gdon yin min gnyis su dbye dgos so/ /de bzhin du phyogs skyong gi 'khor gzhan la'ang 'dra'o/ /me ste sreg bya za ba'i lha ni me lha'i gtso ba'o/ /de nyid me lha'i drang srong gzhan rnams kyi rgyal po ste/ me lha'i rigs kyi gdon rnams kyi bdag po'o/ /de dag gtso cher ri rab kyi shar lho na gnas pa ste lhag ma ni sngar ltar ro/ /gshin rje lag na be con te dbyug pa 'chang ba de nyid ma mo kun gyi rgyal po ste/ gshin rje'i gdon gyi rigs kun gyi bdag po ste/ de la sogs pa lho phyogs gdon gyi tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha ni srin po'i rigs rnams kyi rgyal po ste de'i gdon gyi bdag po'o/ /de sogs lho nub gdon gyi tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha ni klu'i rgyal po ste/ klu'i rigs kyi gdon gyi bdag po'o/ /rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha rig 'dzin rgyal po ni rlung lha rnams kyi gtso bo'o/ /de ni rlung lha'i rigs kyi gdon gyi bdag po'o/ /gnod sbyin lag na dbyug pa thogs pa'i rnam thos sras ni nor sbyin te/ nor lha'i rigs kyi gdon rnams kyi bdag po'o/ /dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha dbang phyug ni 'byung po kun gyi rgyal po ste/ 'byung po'i gdon gyi rigs rnams kyi bdag po'o/ /steng gi gdon gyi gtso bo tshangs pa chen po dang*/ de'i phyogs gtogs nyi ma dang zla ba dang gza'i rgyal po sgra gcan dang*/ mig dmar la sogs gza' gzhan rgyu skar gyi tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ 'og gi klu ste sa yi lha ni klu chen brgyad dang sa'i lha mo brtan ma dang*/ sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang dam tshig shes shing de la gnas pa'i sa bdag gi rigs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa la mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal lo/

/tshangs pa la stong gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pa dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu'i nang tshan gyi tshangs pa gnyis bshad cing*/ snga ma che ba dang phyi ma chung ba ste ngo bo gcig go /gzhan las phyogs skyong bco lnga bshad kyang gtso 'khor gyi dbang du byas na bcur 'du ste/ nye dbang ni dbang po'i 'khor dang*/ tshogs bdag ni gnod sbyin gyi rgyal bo'i 'khor dang*/ thags bzang ris ni log phyogs bar 'du'o/ /phyogs skyong gi gtso bo de dag ni 'jig rten pa ltar bstan yang*/ don la sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa yin te/ de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston pa/ zhes dang*/ gzhung gzhan gyi lung rigs kyis 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te 'jig rten pa'i lha klu sogs la re ltos kyis phyag 'tshal ba mi rigs so zhe na/ thar 'dod rnams kyis 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre la phyi ma'i skyabs mi 'chol yang 'phral rkyen sel ba'i ched du re ltos byed pa mi 'gal lo/ /de nas de dag la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ ru tra ye zhes sogs dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥzhes sogs kyi don ni bshad zin to/ /bsngo zhing 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ shar phyogs rdo rje can te brgya byin gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol lo/ /de bzhin du me lha dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ bden bral gyi srin po rnams kyi bdag po dang*/ chu bdag chu lha'i rgyal po klu dang*/ rlung lha'i bdag po dang*/ nor gyi bdag po gnod sbyin dang*/ dbang ldan gyi lha dbang phyug ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang steng gi lha nyi ma dang zla ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi mes po tshangs pa chen po dang*/ lha rnams kun dang*/ sa 'og gi klu rnams dang*/ gser gyi ri bdun la gnas pa'i lha dang*/ gsang ba gnod sbyin gyi tshogs rnams la ni/ rang rang so so so sor gtor ma 'bul ba rnams rab tu dgyes pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang*/

rang rang so so'i phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su rang gi bu smad dang*/ mdza' bshes kyi grogs dang*/ gnyen 'dun gyi tshogs dang*/ rang gi nang mi gzhan dang*/ dmag sde dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang bcas pa thabs gcig ste lhan cig tu/ me tog dang dri dang byug pa dang gtor mar bcas pa 'di rnams bsngo'o/ /btung zhing legs par gsol ba ste bzhes nas kyang*/ bdag gi re ba'i las 'di'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod cig 'phrin las bsdus pa la de tsam gyis chog cing*/ cung zad rgyas par na khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bsnams pa ste bzhes la/ rnal 'byor ba bdag cag sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa la nad med pa dang*/ tshe ring ba dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ grags pa dang*/ skal ba bzang po dang*/ longs spyod rgya chen po kun thob cing*/ zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa la sogs pa'i las rnams kyi dngos grub bdag cag la stsol ba dang*/ dam tshig can gyi rnal 'byor bdag cag la srung ba dang*/ dngos grub kun gyi 'bras bu 'grub pa'i stongs grogs mdzod cig gzhan yang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/ nad kyi rigs dang*/ gdon dang bgegs kyi rigs rnams ni med par mdzod cig rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan pa ngan pa dang*/ bya byed ngan pa rnams kyang med par mdzod ciga'ajig rten 'di kun bde zhing lo legs pa dang*/ 'bru rnams 'phel zhing dge phyogs kyi chos 'phel ba dang*/ mdor na bde legs phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ yid la bsam pa'i 'dod don thams cad 'grub par shog cig /ces 'phrin las bcol bar bya ste go sla yang mtshon tsam zhig bkral ba'o/ /gnyis pa la sde brgyad kyi rigs su gtogs gdon spyan 'dren pa ni/ lha'i gdon dang*/ lha min gyi gdon dang*/ de bzhin du gnod sbyin dang*/ lto 'phye ste klu'i rigs dang*/ lho'i grul bum dang*/ nam mkha' lding ste khyung dang*/

'dab bzangs te byis gdon gyi nang tshan bya dang*/ lus la dri ngan dro ba'i lus srul po dang*/ dri za dang srin po dang*/ gdon gyi rigs rnams zhes pas smyo byed dang brjed byed dang skem byed dang grib gnon dang gnod po la sa gdon gyi rigs gzhan rnams sdud do/ /gdon gang dag sa gzhi la gnas pa'i yi dwags rdzu 'phrul chen po la sogs pa dang*/ gdon su yang rung ste rang gi bu smad de ma bu dang bcas shing g.yog 'khor gyi tshogs rnams dang bcas pa la/ bdag gis pus mo g.yas pa sa la btsugs nas ni lag pa thal mo sbyar te/ khyed rnams la mchod pa'i ched du 'dir 'byon par zhu zhes gsol ba 'debs kyis/ gsol ba btab pa'i tshig gsan nas gnod pa'i bsam sbyor med par phan gdags pa'i slad du gnas 'dir myur du byon shig ces so/ /sngags ni/ oṃ e hye sogs te/ e hi e hi gnyis mtshams sbyar bas/ e hye hi ste tshur shog gam byon gnyis/ lo ka kā ra ya ni 'jig rten byed pa/ de ba lha/ nā ga klu/ gandha rba dri za/ a su ra lha min/ ga ru ḍa mkha' lding*/ kinna ra mi'am ci/ ma ho ra ga lto 'phye chen po/ ma nu ṣa mi/ a ma nu ṣa mi ma yin/ sa pā ri wa ra 'khor bcas/ sa ma ye dam tshig can no/ /'dir ma nu ṣa zhes mi bgrang byung yang gdon nam sde brgyad la gtor ma 'bul ba'i skabs su mi 'dren pa mi 'thad pa ltar snang yang*/ lha dang lha min zhes sogs kyi spyan 'dren 'di dang*/ 'byung po gang dag zhes sogs kyi gzhung gnyis ka rgya gzhung dag dang*/ khyad par du dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud las 'byung bas ma dag par 'jog mi nus so/ /des na 'di ni gdon 'chad pa'i zhar byung tsam du gsungs par bya dgos so/ /'dir sde brgyad la gtor ma 'bul bar bshad cing*/ 'og tu gshegs gsol gyi skabs su yang sde brgyad gshegs par bsam zhes 'byung bas sde brgyad 'dren tshul ji ltar bya snyam na/

sde brgyad kyi grangs 'dren tshul mi 'dra ba gsum mthong yang*/ gzhung 'di'i tshig zin gyi go rim dang sbyar na/ lha'i sde/ klu'i sde/ gnod sbyin gyi sde/ dri za'i sde/ lha min gyi sde/ nam mkha' ld-ing gi sde/ mi'am ci'i sde/ lto 'phye chen po'i lde ste brgyad do/ /mjug gi mi dang mi ma yin zhes pa'i mi ni zhar byung dang*/ mi ma yin zhes pas mi ma yin gyi gdon rigs kun sdud pa la byas na legs par sems so/ /spyan drangs nas rang rang gi ming brjod pa'i mthar mchod yon dang gdan 'bul ba dang*/ nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa phul nas/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'phul zhing*/ sngags ky-i don ni gong du bshad zin to/ /de nas 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ gdon gyi rigs grangs med pas re re nas ming gis smos su mi lang bas/ gnas ky-i sgo nas brjod de 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ spyir 'byung po zhes pa'i sgra ni don bdun la 'jug par bshad kyang*/ 'dir mi ma yin zhes pa'i don du bya ste/ 'byung po mi ma yin gdon gyi rigs gang dag ri rab kyi steng spyi na gnas pa dang*/ lta na sdug gi byang phyogs dga' ba'i tshal dang*/ chos bzang lha'i 'dun sa sogs lha'i gnas rnams dang*/ shar nub kyi ri dang*/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i gzhal med khang dang*/ gzhu khyim la sogs pa'i khyim bcu gnyis rnams dang*/ gser gyi ri bdun la sogs pa ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang*/ nor bu rin po che'i gling na lhag par gang dag gnas pa dang*/ gaṅgā dang pakṣu la sogs pa'i chu bo chen po dang*/ chu bo'i mdo chu rnams 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho rnams dang*/ mtsho phran dang*/ rdzing bu dang*/ lteng ka dang*/ chu ngogs te khron pa dang*/ g.ya' chu dang*/ sil ma can te tsha gdung sel nus pa'i bsil chu na gnas pa dang*/ skye bo gnas pa'i grong dang*/ phyugs gnas pa'i lhas dang*/

mi med pa'i grong khyer stong pa dang*/ khang stong dang*/ lha'i khang pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang chen po dang*/ mchod rten zhig po'i gnas rnams dang*/ dka' thub pa'i gnas dang*/ glang po che'i bres rnams dang*/ rgyal po'i dkor mdzod kyi khang ba dag na gang dag gnas pa dang*/ lam srang sum mdo dang*/ bzhi 'dus pa'i bzhi mdo dang*/ gang dag shing rta'i 'khor lo bzhi dang ldan pas bgrod par byas pa'i lam po chai dang*/ shing gzhan gyi grib mas mi non pa gcig paur gyur pa'i shing gcig pa dang*/ dur khrod chen po dag dang*/ nags tshal chen po dang*/ seṅge dang dred dang stag la sogs pa gcan gzan gyi gnas dag dang*/ skye bos dben pa'i 'brog chen dgon pa 'jigs su rungabar gang dag gnas pa dang*/ gang dag mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang*/ lhun po'i sgras brjod pa ri rab manda ra'i dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams te/ de rnams rab tu yid dga' zhing mgu bar gyur nas/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ mar me dang bcas pa bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags na/ 'di dag btung zhing legs par gsol zhing bzhes nas kyang*/ bdag gis bsgrub pa'i las 'di'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod cig ces pa'o/ /gsum pa la bgegs 'gug pa ni/ gong du hūṃ mdzad kyi bskyed chog ma byas na 'dir skad cig gis der bsgyur te 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya byas nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang zhes sogs brjod par byas nas bgegs kyi rigs gang 'gug 'dod pa rnams skad cig thang cig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭakki hūṃ dzaḥzhes brjod pas mdun du bkug par bsam/ ṭakki ni 'dod pa ste/ 'dod rgyal gyi mtshan zur dang*/ hūṃ ni de'i sa bon/ dzaḥni 'gug sngags so/ /oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swāhā zhes pa'i gung gnyis ni/ srin po'i ming ngam sa bon yin la/ ka ra ni byed pa zhes so/

/pi tsi ni pi tsi ni 'jam po 'jam po ste sha za'i ming du bshad cing*/ gung gung ni 'byung po bgegs spyi'i ming ngo*/ /sa pā ri wa ra sogs ni sngar bshad zin cing*/ mchod yon dang*/ gdon dang*/ nyer spyod rol mo dang*/ sngags kyis gtor ma 'bul zhing don ni sngar ltar ro/ /de nas 'phrin las bcol te gshegs par zhu pa'o/ /gzhung 'di rgya gzhung du ma las 'byung bas don ni/ bgegs kyi rigs gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yi 'byung po dang*/ sha za dang*/ srin po sha rjen za ba dang*/ de sogs sems can bgegs kyi rigs rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ ljon shing chen po dang*/ phran bu shing gel ba la sogs na gnas pa de dang de la gtor ma ni/ bza' ba'i zas sha dang chang dang la phug dang bcas pa dang*/ 'bras dang shing tog gi 'bras bu mang po dang bcas pa'i mchod pa 'di yis yid mgu bar byos la/ gnod pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa zhi ba dang*/ bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid ni de ring phan chad bskyed par gyis shigaskyes bu gang zhig lus rgyan gyis brgyan par byas nas yid chos la spyod cing*/ sems dul zhing mi mthun phyogs las yang dag par bsdom la tshangs par spyod cing*/ 'byung po sems can kun la gnod pa'i chad pa spangs pa gang yin pa ste/ de nyid rab tu byung ngam ma byung gang yin kyang don gyi dge slong dang dge sbyong de yin zhing*/ bram ze bzang po yang de yin no/ /da lta'i sha rus brdos bcas kyi lus 'di lta bu dang ldan pa'i gang zag la mtshon chas mi 'jigs shing mi skrag pa gang yang med de/ 'tsho ba'i srog la kun kyang mtshon la 'dzem mo/ /de'i phyir gnod byed khyed cag rang gi lus srog la gces 'dzin gyis gnod pa kun la 'dzem par byed pa'i dpe long la/ sems can gzhan gyi lus srog la gnod pa ma byed cig ces so/ /oṃ chen po'am zhes sogs te/ bgegs byaid rnams kyis sems can gyi rigs las gang zag chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gi lus la mngon par gnod par gyur pa'i nad de nye bar phyung nas su gdon de khyed rnams rang gi gnas su dengs te song zhig

gshegs gsol des kyang chog mod/ cung zad spros pa ni/ de ltar bdag gis mi nus kyi sgo nas khyed rnams la mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yi stobs kyis khyed rnams mi gnod cing phan pa bsgrub pa'i dam tshig la gnas nas su/ phyin chad bdag cag gi 'dod pa'i re ba bskang bar mdzod cig /rtag tu de lta bu'i dam tshig la gnas shing 'dir ni sbyin bdag sogs che ge mo 'di zhes bya ba zhig gi nad de nye bar sol mdzod la/ da gdon bgegs rnams rang gi gnas su dengs te song zhig ces so/ /gsum pa la thog mar bgegs gshegs pa ni/ sarba bighnaṃ gatstsha ni bgegs thams cad song zhes pa ste/ bgegs rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur par bsam/ de nas sngags brjod/ mchod yon phul bas gatstsha zhes dang*/ sde brgyad rang gnas su gshegs par gyur par bsam/ de nas rang rang gi mtshan sngags brjod cing*/ mchod yon phul te gatstsha phyogs skyong 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur par bsam/ de nas/ na maḥs manta zhes sogs lan gsum gyis yi dwags la gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /spyan 'dren gyi rim pa'i dbang du byas na phyogs skyong sngon du gshegs rigs kyang*/ 'dir bgegs sngon la gshegs pa ni gtor ma phul ba'i 'phror 'jug pa bde ba dang*/ yang bgegs gnod sems che bas sngon dang*/ de nas gdon dang*/ de nas phyogs skyong gshegs pa'o/ / bgegs rnams ni gdon gyi rigs yin kyang gdug sems che ba 'ga' zhig bye brag tu bkar bar snang ngo*/ /'khod pa'i rim pa ni phyogs skyong rnams nang ngos dang*/ gzhan gnyis de'i phyi rol tu rim par gnas par bsam par bya ste/ steng 'og tu bsgom na phyogs skyong rnams steng du bsam dgos shing*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs yin min lta bu la khyad par shes dgos so/ /mjug tu dkyil 'khor chen po zhes sogs kyis bka' bgos kyang mi rung ba mi snang yang*/

gshegs zin pa'i mjug tu bka' bsgo ba ni cung mi 'brel bas/ mtshams gcod dang zlaug pa byas na legs so/ /gnyis pa 'phros bshad pa ni/ nad pa lta bu'i rim gro la cha gsum gtong bar byas na legs par ma zad/ bgegs gtor btang na phan khyad che bas cung zad brjod na/ bgegs gtor gsum dang*/ ting lo chang bu dang bcas pa sta gon bya/ nad pa'i ched du glud rgyan can dang*/ mdun du gtor ma dang*/ ting lo chang bu ril bu mtheb kyu 'bru dar sogs ci 'grub byas te/ rang nyid hūṃ mdzad dam/ 'jigs byed/ phyag rdor/ rta mgrin lta bu yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dzā sa pā ri wa ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ ye shes bskal pa zhes sogs spyan 'dren dang*/ mchod bstod spyi ltar byas nas/ bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i mtshams su/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ

mam oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur par bsams te/ oṃ a kā ros lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ gnod byed gdon bgegs kyi tshogs rnams mdun du bkug par gyur/ oṃ sarba bighnaṃ sogs dang*/ sumbha ni sogs lan gsum gyis spyi ltar bsngo/ glud med na/ dkyil 'khor chen po sogs kyis bgegs la bka' bsgaus te/ bden stobs brjod cing*/ mi 'gro ba rnams la drag sngags sumbha ni brjod pa dang mnyam du yungs kar sogs kyis brdeg cing bskrad nas/ sher snying gi zlog pa bya'o/ /glud yod na/ gtor ma bsngos te gtor ro glud kyi mthar ram/ de dang nye bar bzhag nas/ glud rdzas dang bcas pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las glud dbang po kun tshang zhing phung khams skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa rgyan cha lugs dang bcas pa dang*/ yo byad kyi gtor rdzas rnams lha mi'i yo byad 'dod rgu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ a kā ro dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥ nas/ ga ga ṇa khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis byin brlab bya/ de nas glud bsngo ba'i tshul la rgyas bsdus mang yang mtshon tsam brjod na/ ༈ /kyai/ nga ni khro rgyal chen po ste/ nga yi bka' la mi nyan med/ /gnod byed gdon gyi rigs rnams kun/ /nga yis bsgo ba'i bka' la nyon/ /khyad par sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs la/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di sbyin gyis/ /nga yi bka' la nyan par gyis/ /de ring khyed rnams thams cad la/ /mdzes shing rgyan ldan glud 'di 'bul/ /mi 'di'i dod du glud 'di longs/ /glud 'di phung khams skye mched tshang*/ /yo byad mkho rgu thams cad ldan/

/'di ni mi 'di'i dod du 'os/ /mi las lhag pa'i glud chen 'di/ /gtor ma mar me 'bru sna dang*/ /rin chen dar sna la sogs pa/ /mkho rgu'i yo byad tshogs dang bcas/ /de ring khyed rnams kun la 'bul/ /glud 'di longs la sbyin bdag gi /nad dang gnod pa zhi bar gyis/ /sngon chad khyed la gnod gyur pa'i/ /khon dang zhe 'gras yod na yang*/ /mdzes ldan glud chen 'di bzhes la/ /bzod bzhes khon 'dzin med par mdzod/ /bzung ba thog la bcings pa khrol/ /mnan pa 'khyog la bsdoms pa lhod*/ /nad kyi gdung ba da phyung zhig /dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' ma bcag/ las 'bras bslu ba med la soms/ /phan pa'i 'bras bu bde ba dang*/ /gnod pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung*/ /rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan dag la ni gnod ma byed/ /de phyir gnod byed gdon tshogs kyis/ /glud dang gtor rdzas 'di bzhes nas/ /bsam sbyor ngan pa kun spong la/ /rang gi gnas su 'gro bar mdzod/ /ces brjod cing*/ hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi sogs kyis bka' bsgo ba dang*/ bden stobs brjod cing mi 'gro ba rnams drag sngags sogs kyis bskrad de/ glud dang gtor ma rnams phyir bskyal zhing*/ zlog pa dang shis brjod dang srung ba bya'o/ /nad gdon bgegs kyis zin gyur pa'i/ /'gro ba 'ga' la phan pa'i ched/ /cha gsum gtong bar 'dod pa la/ /de yi dmigs rim gsal ba dang*/ /gdon bgegs rigs la gtor glud bcas/ /bshad pa'i dge des 'gro ba kun/ /mi mthun phyogs las grol gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang*/ shākya'i btsun pa grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas re gnyis la phan 'dod kyi bsam pas co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo// // maṅgalaṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ cha gsum gyi 'grel ba bgegs gtor gtong tshul dang bcas pa bzhugs/
